text.description_html:
Fusion PH-B2, Round Rose Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder

The Traditional Round Mount Toilet Paper Roll Holder is a great addition to any bathroom because its classic shape allows it to look great no matter how your tastes change throughout the years. It is easy to install, and can be mounted to hang in either direction. It is versatile too, with a swinging arm that allows for even the biggest rolls of toilet tissue. The round radius rose toilet paper holder is available in antique pewter, antique copper, and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-B2 Traditional Round Mount Towel Bar, Fusion TR-B2 Traditional Round Mount Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-B2 Traditional Round Mount Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Round Radius Toilet Tissue Holder:

  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
